class Animal { name = 'animal'; }
class Dog extends Animal { bark() { return 'woof'; } }

const handlers = {
  handle(animal: Animal) { return animal.name; },
  ['computed'](animal: Animal) { return animal.name; },
};

const callback: typeof handlers.handle = (dog: Dog) => dog.bark();
const computed: typeof handlers.computed = (dog: Dog) => dog.bark();
const other: typeof handlers = {
  handle(dog: Dog) { return dog.bark(); },
  computed(dog: Dog) { return dog.bark(); },
};

abstract class AbstractHandlers {
  abstract handle(animal: Animal): string;
}

const abstractMethod: AbstractHandlers['handle'] = (dog: Dog) => dog.bark();
const dog = new Dog();
console.log(callback(dog), computed(dog), other.handle(dog), abstractMethod(dog));
